notes.title: Feature Updates on V0.1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since our last update — we hope you're doing well!
We've made several improvements to the features and content in the Early Access build to better reflect the level of polish we originally envisioned.
We’d love for you to try the updated demo and let us know what you think of the changes!

[h2]Patch Notes : 0.1.2[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modified Item Navigations, now cannot select Previous Item, The item switch has one button that cycles, also modified item use Input for controller to "D-Pad Up"
[*] Modified Shop and Inventory system while shopping. If you buy food, it is stored in Stella's backpack rather than Stella's storage; it goes to the storage if your backpack is full.
[*] Fixed bug where in pause menu input freezes if player navigate left and right on City pause menu
[*] Removed any text regarding objectives and objective Indicators on Status and Inventory Pause Panel temporarily, to prevent the panel to disappear due to no city objective present.
[*] "Back To City" in combat pause menu only available when the player already beat the prologue, Fixed the bug where it appears when the player plays the stage for the first time.
[*] Fixed Bike teleport errors, and oddities when you can teleport on the same bike.
[*] Fixed Medal not appearing when player skips most animations in Result Screen
[*] Training Area infinite cost lever has a text called "No Cost" to remind you that you make skills and ultimate bar full and no cost
[*] Fixed Resolution Data problem, sometimes it generates data that should be filtered, now add Player's display resolutions if they are not in our list, now the capping system so no overboard resolutions should work
[*] Fixed the money resetting whenever Autosave is triggered, this is due Autosave only accounts one Field Type, now most data can be saved (money, exp, skills, items) regardless of field type
[*] Fixed wrong and mismatch UI on the Combat Inventory UI when selecting item after Retry/Restart that accidentally select the Index 2 when it supposed to be Index 0 (first item player have)
[*] Fixed Gamepad bind, that broken after the Item switch reduced to one button.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing and Quality of Life Improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extended Stella's critical state to 20% HP of Max HP
[*] Reduced Stella's shield power to 15
[*] In Challenge Arena 2, the Prisoner at the end should have the free animation triggered
[*] Replaced Volume Bar slider sprite into a standard unity square
[*] Adjusted effect tabs in Item Descriptions on shops and inventory
[*] Allowed control input while Stella is in recovery frames.
[*] Allowed walk input after landing from a jump/fall. 
[*] Reduced Stella's default knockout/down time so that she can start to move again earlier.
[/list]

[h3]Sound Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted some of the BGMs and SFXs volume intensity to reduce annoying noises.
[*] Resampled some instruments from the previous BGMs.
[*] Changed some SFXs to match the intensity and vibe of the combat better.
[/list]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS BUILD UPDATE 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hey there! 🎄 Great news this Christmas!

We’ve dropped a new patch for our early access build—read the detail here! 🎉

[h2]Patch Notes : 0.1.1[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Gale's dialogue bar would disappear during the Prologue ending (Part 4, right after the Bloody Belly Boss Battle).
[*] Added autosave points at critical moments in the Prologue to prevent loss of progression after crashes. Autosaves have been added during transitions between gameplay modes [b](Battle (Prologue Part 1) → Exploration (Flashback) → Battle (Prologue Part 2) → Exploration (Dream Sequence))[/b].
[*] Fixed a potential game freeze caused by faulty code in the Pause Menu.
[*] Food sometimes may dropped when executing a successful Heat Meter/QTE Ultimate.
[*] Added an autosave after the Result Screen.
[*] Resolved issues with controller stick navigation that cause erratic behavior in some UI menus.
[*] Fixed a bug that could freeze or crash the game when the player hold the Shield during the first Combat Tutorial.
[*] Fixed EXP Points from stages that previously cannot be saved.
[*] Fixed the Hour/Minute/Second format on the load screen menu that are only displaying 12.00.00 AM.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Renamed some settings information to avoid misinformation.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the Heat Meter's decay rate to improve gameplay flow.
[*] Lowered Medal Score calculations and thresholds, resulting in reduced prize money.[i] (Note: If you received a large amount of money before this update, consider it a gift! 😊)[/i]
[*] Simplified the first Combat Tutorial for a smoother introduction.
[*] Increased the range of dodges.
[/list]
[h3]Contents[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can enable Unlimited Skill and Ultimate points on Training Area.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enabled[b] Steam Cloud[/b] Saves for the game. 
[*] Adjusted the naming conventions for the game's save folders.
[/list]
Because we are adding Steam Cloud and changing the save directory, you may lose your data. If this happens, please follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Go to the game save folder and copy all files, including the folder. The save files are located at: [b]\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\extralife2\_TRIALSOFFAITH[/b]
[*] Paste the old save data into the new location. The new save files are located at: [b]\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\Extra Life Entertainment\StellaGale[/b]
[*] That’s it! Now you can play the game with your previous save files.
[/olist]

Stay tuned for an even[b] bigger update coming soon[/b], and [b]Merry Christmas![/b] 🎅✨

notes.title: PLAY THE FULL DEMO NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uCNZZ3B1TYw;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everyone, we're proudly present our Full Prologue Demo of StellaGale The Trial of Faith!

[h2]Embark on a captivating journey with our Full Demo. Explore rich landscapes, unravel the prologue of Stella’s story, and dive into the complete gaming experience. This demo offers a taste of the full adventure that awaits you in the world of StellaGale Trial of Faith.[/h2]

I also want to share some changes we made for a course a year :

[h3]COMBAT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/0e1a3b4b30e05bec2dfb7a2433437b9de9b12156.gif[/img]
The gameplay feel has undergone a significant transformation from what it used to be. In the current version, it is evident that every damage dealt is impactful and leaves a strong impression. We added camera shakes, slow motion, splash screens, and updated the damage visual effects to make battles even more engaging and visually appealing.

[h3]BACKGROUND COMBAT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/04971b94758d75b3eda4736e2fdbae97f4fa0d4b.gif[/img]
We added depth to the arena by incorporating numerous assets into the foreground. Compared to before, which may have seemed empty and close, now players can feel a more dense and expansive arena.

[h3]XTREME MODE SYSTEM (Previously called Ultimate / Conveyor System)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/4fc6752a1bdb4fa23063b98c91377a911c529e2a.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The skill conveyor has been slightly modified to make it easier for players to distinguish between the gauge for regular skills and the gauge for Xtreme skills. We have also added controls above the buttons so that players can easily preview the skills they are about to use.
[*] We removed the storing system to make it easier for players during Xtreme execution. This decision was based on feedback from our testers, as pressing the L1+R1 buttons for storing proved to be cumbersome. As a result, we focused on the core element, which is the combination of skills. Now, players only need to hold L1 and input the combination.
[/list]

[h3]AUDIO & MUSIC[/h3]
[list]
[*] We made massive changes to the music and audio, successfully incorporating voices that enhance the excitement of battles, including voices for Stella, enemies, and even Gale.
[*] Added sound effects (SFX) to many parts of the gameplay. This is also a significant change that has a substantial impact on the current state of the game.
[/list]

[h3]STORY DIRECTION & SYSTEM[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/2c3399d1e6f37ce04b4a9f26c6faf60a1efac1b5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Fungus update (control & animation). We added control to fasten & auto-play cutscenes. This will be very useful for players to control their own pace. 
[*] We added music & audio to cutscene, so the story felt more alive.
[/list]

[h3]EXPLORATION CITY[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/40aedba1c2478ff6b3010f7718778f922a47e170.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] We added shadows and lighting to the city, as well as visual effects like waves and particle leaves. This makes the city come even more alive.
[*] Animated Vfx background. We added many VFX animations to improve the visual experience.
[*] Background assets for the Main City are improved. The city is now more alive. All details are now painted in more detail.
[/list]

[h3]BONUS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/6cab2b116cdc57c434e2f08309261e1c96432e5b.gif[/img]
We also added tip or gratuity mechanic to the game. So, when you did something amazing, the crowd will reward you with money. 

******************************************************************************************

The team has done tremendous work and we spend a lot of time making the game better and fully playable. I hope you can feel it when you play the game. If you have feedback or have found any bugs, you can report us on the discussion panel.

[h3]Let's meet again at Steam Next Fest February 2024[/h3]
